metadata.title: Global Port Community Systems Directory
metadata.description: Comprehensive dataset of Port Community Systems (PCS) worldwide, compiled from IPCSA membership data and public sources.
metadata.source: IPCSA (International Port Community Systems Association) - https://ipcsa.international/
metadata.author: Robert Richard das Neves Correia dos Santos

pcs_systems.name: Portbase
pcs_systems.description: National Port Community System for all Dutch seaports. Connects over 4,500 companies in the logistics chain.

pcs_systems.name: DAKOSY
pcs_systems.description: Data Communication System for the Port of Hamburg. Central platform for import and export processing.

pcs_systems.name: SOGET (S)ONE
pcs_systems.description: Leading PCS provider in France, facilitating trade and logistics flows in Le Havre and multiple French ports.

pcs_systems.name: Portic
pcs_systems.description: The official Port Community System of the Port of Barcelona, integrating all logistics stakeholders.

pcs_systems.name: MCP (Destin8)
pcs_systems.description: Maritime Cargo Processing operating the Destin8 PCS across major UK ports.

pcs_systems.name: dbh Logistics IT AG
pcs_systems.description: Operates the Port Community System for the ports of Bremen and Bremerhaven.

pcs_systems.name: NxtPort (APCS)
pcs_systems.description: Data sharing platform and PCS for the Port of Antwerp-Bruges, connecting port stakeholders.

pcs_systems.name: ValenciaportPCS
pcs_systems.description: Technological platform for the port community of Valencia, facilitating paperless trade.

pcs_systems.name: CNS (Compass)
pcs_systems.description: Customs Clearance and Port Community System provider serving multiple UK ports.

pcs_systems.name: MGI (Ci5)
pcs_systems.description: Marseille Gyptis International operating the Ci5 port community system for southern French ports.

pcs_systems.name: TPCS
pcs_systems.description: Tuscan Port Community System serving the Tuscan port network in Italy.

pcs_systems.name: Polski PCS
pcs_systems.description: National Port Community System of Poland serving the Baltic Sea ports.

pcs_systems.name: HPCS
pcs_systems.description: Hellenic Port Community System connecting stakeholders in Greek ports.

pcs_systems.name: AP+
pcs_systems.description: Port community system serving the Port of Gothenburg, Scandinavia's largest port.

pcs_systems.name: PortIC Algeciras
pcs_systems.description: Port community system for the Bay of Algeciras, one of the Mediterranean's busiest ports.

pcs_systems.name: UIrS / Sinfomar
pcs_systems.description: Port community system for the Port of Genoa, Italy's largest port by cargo volume.

pcs_systems.name: Portnet
pcs_systems.description: World's first nationwide B2B port community system. Connects over 10,000 users across 100+ countries.

pcs_systems.name: KL-Net (PORT-MIS)
pcs_systems.description: Korea Logistics Network operating the PORT-MIS system for South Korean ports.

pcs_systems.name: NACCS
pcs_systems.description: Nippon Automated Cargo and Port Consolidated System, Japan's national trade platform.

pcs_systems.name: Port Klang Net
pcs_systems.description: Port Community System for Port Klang, Malaysia's busiest port.

pcs_systems.name: Kale CODEX
pcs_systems.description: Community-oriented digital exchange platform for Indian ports, operated by Kale Logistics.

pcs_systems.name: TPCS / T-Port
pcs_systems.description: Thailand's port data exchange system serving Laem Chabang and Bangkok ports.

pcs_systems.name: LOGINK
pcs_systems.description: China's National Transportation & Logistics Public Information Platform connecting ports nationwide.

pcs_systems.name: Tay Ninh PCS
pcs_systems.description: Port community system implementation for Vietnamese ports and logistics corridors.

pcs_systems.name: Dubai Trade
pcs_systems.description: Premier cross-border trade facilitation hub and single window for Dubai's ports.

pcs_systems.name: Maqta Gateway
pcs_systems.description: Abu Dhabi's digital trade and logistics single window and port community system.

pcs_systems.name: FASAH
pcs_systems.description: Saudi Arabia's national single window and port community system managed by Saudi Ports Authority (Mawani).

pcs_systems.name: Asyad (Bayan)
pcs_systems.description: Oman's integrated logistics platform connecting ports and trade stakeholders.

pcs_systems.name: PortNet
pcs_systems.description: National Single Window and Port Community System of Morocco serving all Moroccan ports.

pcs_systems.name: KenTrade (KENTWS)
pcs_systems.description: Kenya Trade Network Agency managing the national electronic single window system.

pcs_systems.name: TNPA Navis N4

pcs_systems.name: GUCE
pcs_systems.description: Guichet Unique du Commerce Extérieur – Cameroon's single window for port operations.

pcs_systems.name: GAINDE 2000
pcs_systems.description: Senegal's trade facilitation and port community platform.

pcs_systems.name: Port Optimizer
pcs_systems.description: Information portal digitizing maritime shipping data for the Port of Los Angeles.

pcs_systems.name: eModal
pcs_systems.description: Widely used community portal across North American ports for truck appointments and payments.

pcs_systems.name: Suape PCS
pcs_systems.description: Port community system for the Port of Suape, one of Brazil's major northeastern ports.

pcs_systems.name: Porto Sem Papel
pcs_systems.description: Brazil's national port single window system (Paperless Port), managed by the federal government.

pcs_systems.name: VUCE
pcs_systems.description: Ventanilla Única de Comercio Exterior – Peru's single window covering port community functions.

pcs_systems.name: SICEX
pcs_systems.description: Argentina's foreign trade single window integrating port and customs operations.

pcs_systems.name: 1-Stop Connections
pcs_systems.description: Provider of port community systems and terminal appointment systems across Australian ports.

pcs_systems.name: Lyttelton PCS
pcs_systems.description: Port community coordination system for the Port of Lyttelton, New Zealand's South Island.
